name: ms_mason_stothers
statement: {k : Type*} [Field k] (a b c : Polynomial k) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0) (hab : IsCoprime a b) (hbc : IsCoprime b c) (hca : IsCoprime c a) (hsum : a + b + c = 0) : (Polynomial.derivative a = 0 ∧ Polynomial.derivative b = 0 ∧ Polynomial.derivative c = 0) ∨ max (max a.natDegree b.natDegree) c.natDegree < (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.radical (a * b * c)).natDegree
closed: ∀ {k : Type*} [Field k] (a b c : Polynomial k) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0) (hab : IsCoprime a b) (hbc : IsCoprime b c) (hca : IsCoprime c a) (hsum : a + b + c = 0), (Polynomial.derivative a = 0 ∧ Polynomial.derivative b = 0 ∧ Polynomial.derivative c = 0) ∨ max (max a.natDegree b.natDegree) c.natDegree < (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.radical (a * b * c)).natDegree
informal: Mason–Stothers: nonzero pairwise coprime a+b+c=0 in k[t] have all derivatives zero or max degree < deg rad(abc).
original: Theorem 1 (Mason–Stothers). Let k be any field and a, b, c ∈ k[t] be nonzero, pairwise coprime polynomials satisfying a + b + c = 0. Then we either have a′ = b′ = c′ = 0 where f′ denotes the (formal) derivative of f ∈ k[t] by t, or max{deg(a), deg(b), deg(c)} < deg(rad(abc)).
type: ∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] (a b c : Polynomial k), a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 → c ≠ 0 → IsCoprime a b → IsCoprime b c → IsCoprime c a → a + b + c = 0 → Polynomial.derivative a = 0 ∧ Polynomial.derivative b = 0 ∧ Polynomial.derivative c = 0 ∨ max (max a.natDegree b.natDegree) c.natDegree < sorry
